newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery Ward names vice chairman, COO.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery Ward names vice chairman, COO.

text.p: Montgomery Ward & Co Inc, a large, privately held retailer in the United States, said Monday it appointed Burnett Donoho to the newly created positions of vice chairman and chief operating officer.
Donoho will also be a member of both the Montgomery Ward Retail and Montgomery Ward Holding Co. boards of directors.
Donoho will be responsible for all operational aspects of the business including stores and logistics, finance and information systems, and legal and real estate, the retailer said in a statement.

"This appointment is the beginning of a plan to assemble the right management team to lead Montgomery Ward back to profitability," Roger Goddu, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
A company spokeswoman could not say how long the company has not been profitable.

Prior to joining Montgomery Ward, Donoho, 57, had managed his own retail consulting firm. In 1995, he was chief operating officer of The Broadway stores and before that he was vice chairman and chief operating officer for Macy's East.

Montgomery Ward operates 400 specialty stores in 43 states. It is also the parent company of Lechmere, a retailer of electronics and home products in the New England area, and the Signature Group, a direct marketer.
